subject: Post-call: assessment matrix & focused test plan
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaplay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: assessment matrix & focused test plan

Thanks again for the time this morning — appreciated the candid run-through of Novaplay's requirements. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. If anything below is off, flag it and we'll adjust.

Call recap (high level)
- Primary goals: reliable function/tool calling, strict structured-output conformance (JSON schema), and predictable streaming latency for live annotations.
- Secondary considerations: throughput at 100 concurrent sessions, cost per 1k tokens, and telemetry / audit logs for security/compliance.
- Current blockers: lack of sandbox credentials (needed for automated tests), and procurement request for a short-term eval contract.

Proposed focused test plan (3 priority experiments)
1) Function-calling fidelity (owner: Ben) — sanity + edge-case suite to verify: correct action selection, argument typing, nullable fields, and safe-fallback behavior when model abstains. Expected metric: 95% intent->action mapping accuracy across 500 calls.
2) Structured-output conformance (owner: Laura) — validate model output against Novaplay's JSON schemas (order/transaction events). Tests: schema validation, extra/missing fields, and ordering determinism. Expected metric: 99% schema pass rate for successful flows.
3) Streaming latency and chunk integrity (owner: Ava) — measure first-byte latency, steady-state token throughput, and behavior under dropped segments. Tests: 30s live session simulation at 100 concurrent streams. Expected metric: p95 first-byte < 200ms, no chunk reordering observed.

Attachments: I uploaded an initial evaluation matrix and a draft test plan (attached to this thread). These are scaffolding — we will iterate after your feedback.

Ask / next steps
- Novaplay: confirm priority order above, and share sandbox IAM creds or a short-lived API key for the eval cluster (scoped to test project).
- Redwood: we'll provide a test harness, sample data, and a runbook; propose a three-day window next week to run the automated suites.

Tentative schedule: run automated suites Wed–Fri next week (we can compress if you prefer single-day smoke).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate owners once we get confirmation.

—
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaplay.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: assessment matrix & focused test plan

Thanks, Ava — that aligns with what we discussed. A couple clarifications and requests: 

1) Priority order: function-calling fidelity is #1 for us (we're replacing a brittle RPC layer), structured outputs #2, streaming #3. If you can get fast wins on function-calling that will sway procurement.
2) Sandbox access: I can ask infra to spin up scoped keys. ETA for creds is Wed morning (we'll send an encrypted note).
3) Data: we'll provide a redacted sample of event payloads by EOD tomorrow.
4) Metrics: the accuracy thresholds look reasonable — want to confirm whether your harness will run head-to-head against their current provider (we can arrange parallel endpoints).

One ask from procurement: can Redwood provide a short-term evaluation agreement (60-day) with limited usage credits for the sandbox run? If so, send me a contact or one-pager we can route.

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync after we have keys. Thanks again.

—
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering | Novaplay
liam@novaplay.com | +1 617-555-4021
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaplay.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: assessment matrix & focused test plan

Looping in our test engineering approach + what we need from Novaplay. I drafted a concrete plan in the attached test plan PDF but high level below.

Test harness & methodology
- We'll spin up a lightweight harness in your sandbox that executes scenario scripts against both Redwood endpoints and Novaplay's current provider (parallel runs). Harness features: replayable seeds, deterministic RNG, request/response logging to GCS, and JSON schema validator with diff output.
- Data: need the redacted event payloads (Maya mentioned). Also need 500 annotated function-call examples for the fidelity suite.
- Failure modes to capture: silent truncation, malformed JSON, incorrect tool invocation, and streaming chunk loss.

Redwood differentiators we'll surface during tests
- Smart routing & fallbacks: can auto-route to a smaller model variant if tail latency spikes (helps sustained throughput).
- Deterministic structured outputs: encoder-side schema enforcement layer to reduce malformed JSONs.
- Streaming: continuous-batching + early-token flush reduces first-byte latency in bursty workloads.

Ownership / timeline
- Ben: lead on function-calling suite (Wed–Thu).
- Laura: structured schema validation + dataset prep (Thu).
- Ava: streaming harness + coordination with Novaplay infra (Fri run).

I attached the detailed plan and the initial evaluation matrix (novaplay_eval_matrix_v1.xlsx). Once we have the keys, I'll schedule the harness run and share runbook + post-run report template.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
